text.p: Ventures Resource Corp said Wednesday it has recorded with the state of Alaska a large block of claims that share a nine mile common boundary with Placer Dome Inc's 5.3 million ounce Donlin Creek gold property.

In April 1996, Placer Dome reported its Donlin Creek property contained 3.6 million ounces of "measured and indicated mineralization" and 1.7 million ounces of "inferred mineralization," Ventures noted in a statement.
Ventures said its 9,000 acre property - Donlin North - stretches for 4.4 miles along the projected mineralized trend of the Donlin Creek ore deposit.
Ventures said it, Placer Dome and Cominco Ltd have been actively acquiring properties in the immediate vicinity of Donlin Creek and Flat.
As a result, the three companies control a large number of the prospective sites in the region, Ventures said.
"In addition, Ventures has recorded claims on 12 other geologic prospects, representing 12,000 acres," said chief executive Greg Sheardown.

"Each of these prospects are geologically similar to the known gold deposits at Donlin Creek and in the Flat mining district. The prospects are located between Placer's Donlin Creek property to the south and the historic mining district of Flat, 12 miles to the north."
